overview: Dust Storm Barrens are the most dangerous zone in The Grey.
details: Sentient dust storms drift across the barrens, formed from ancient Akheva resonance failures. Vacuum predators hunt inside the storms, invisible and silent.
hooks: A massive dust storm moves against gravity.
Storm entities gather near a resonance dune.
A predator pack hides inside a drifting storm.
A silent storm reveals a buried Akheva chamber.
